headline: Police HQ issues nationwide alert over possible attacks on police vehicles
summary: Intelligence indicates that jeeps, pickup trucks, and buses could be targeted by extremist groups or miscreants.
details: Police Headquarters has issued a nationwide alert warning of possible attacks on police vehicles by members of extremist groups or other miscreants.
The directive, issued on Saturday, instructs all police units to strengthen security measures for their vehicles, including jeeps, pickup trucks, and buses.
To prevent incidents, police vehicles temporarily halted during duty must be parked in secure locations and kept under surveillance, and must not be left unattended.
Security for vehicles parked inside police stations, office compounds, and police lines after duty hours must also be enhanced.
Additional IGP (crime and operations) Khondker Rafiqul Islam stated that the directive was issued as a precautionary measure.
He noted that there may be programs by banned organizations centering on the month of August, prompting the high-priority alert.
caption:
Police vehicles nationwide are under threat. HQ has issued a high-priority alert to prevent attacks by extremist groups.

Police Headquarters has issued a nationwide alert warning of possible attacks on police vehicles by members of extremist groups or other miscreants.

The directive, issued on Saturday, instructs all police units to strengthen security measures for their vehicles, including jeeps, pickup trucks, and buses.

To prevent incidents, police vehicles temporarily halted during duty must be parked in secure locations and kept under surveillance, and must not be left unattended.

Security for vehicles parked inside police stations, office compounds, and police lines after duty hours must also be enhanced.

Additional IGP (crime and operations) Khondker Rafiqul Islam stated that the directive was issued as a precautionary measure.

He noted that there may be programs by banned organizations centering on the month of August, prompting the high-priority alert.

headline_marked: BNP [[authorizes Tarique Rahman to finalize]] presidential candidate
headline: BNP authorizes Tarique Rahman to finalize presidential candidate
summary: The party's Standing Committee has handed over the responsibility of nominating a candidate for the presidency to the BNP chairman.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially authorized its chairman, Tarique Rahman, to finalize the selection of the party's candidate for the presidency.
This decision was made during a meeting of the party's Standing Committee, where the responsibility of nominating the candidate was formally delegated to the party chief.
The move comes as the party prepares for the upcoming presidential selection process, ensuring that the final decision rests with the top leadership.
According to party sources, the Standing Committee believes that the chairman is best positioned to make a strategic decision regarding the nomination.
caption:
Who will be the BNP's presidential candidate? The decision now rests solely with Tarique Rahman.

The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially authorized its chairman, Tarique Rahman, to finalize the selection of the party's candidate for the presidency.

This decision was made during a meeting of the party's Standing Committee, where the responsibility of nominating the candidate was formally delegated to the party chief.

The move comes as the party prepares for the upcoming presidential selection process, ensuring that the final decision rests with the top leadership.

According to party sources, the Standing Committee believes that the chairman is best positioned to make a strategic decision regarding the nomination.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
